name: 06824 · Fairfield, CT
findings: ZIP 06824 (Fairfield) has 189 nonprofit organizations. 74 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06824 (Fairfield) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
